title: An untitled page
markdown:
This is a sample page. It can hold a longer piece of writing, a picture, a link, or something unfinished.

There is no required structure. A page can change over time.

## A section, if needed

Text can connect to [a small note](/page/note) or [a saved link](/page/link). Those pages can be small enough to stand on their own.

- A line of text.
- Something to come back to.
- A link to [an unfinished page](/page/unfinished).

## A place for a video

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jfKfPfyJRdk

A sample video. Its original URL stays in the Markdown.
